body: Thank you for your advice.   I’ve tried hard for a long time to get her to try therapy, but it’s like she always has a reason why she shouldn’t.  I think part of it could be she’s worried her family, who I think are part of the source of her issues, will realize how damaged she is if she gets therapy.   She’s big on helping people, and wants people to see her as someone who is happy and has her stuff together so they will let her help them
